protocol.activation_path: exact BF16 for Q/K/V/gate and exact F32 for output

protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_f16_decode_q8_full_gate.py --activation-path q8r4_exact --modes all,qkv_gate,output --scopes all --decode-tokens 16 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-f16-q8r4-exact-full-gate.json

validation.red: candidate test collection failed because the Q8R4 module did not exist
validation.green: 4 candidate tests plus 4 existing full-gate tests passed
validation.gpu_oracle: BF16-to-F32 and F32-to-BF16 candidate GEMVs matched the dequantized CPU representation oracle
validation.dispatch: all 240 source-F16 weights intercepted at the intended exact-activation boundaries

decision.conclusion: The 18.75%-smaller Q8-base/Q4-residual representation is still far outside Laguna's recurrent quality budget, with output projections alone catastrophically unstable. The scalar diagnostic consumer is also slower than the exact-F16 control. Remove the complete candidate and do not pursue another blockwise residual source-F16 representation without a materially stronger calibration premise.
